::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/portal_sessions/{id}"}
#docs
`status` is created → logged_in → logged_out; `revoked_at` is set independently when the session was revoked. `login_at` is when the link was opened, `last_used_at` the latest portal request.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | psess_… portal session public id |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `portal_session`. One of `portal_session`. |
| `id` | `string` | The portal session id. |
| `status` | `string` | The session state. One of `created`, `logged_in`, `logged_out`. |
| `link_kind` | `string` | How the link was made: `api` for an API call, `email` for a billing email. One of `api`, `email`. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the session was created. |
| `access_expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the link stops working for a first sign-in. |
| `expires_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The latest time the session can last. |
| `login_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the customer first opened the link. |
| `logout_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the customer signed out. |
| `last_used_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the session last made a request. |
| `revoked_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the session was revoked, or null. |
| `redirect_url` | `string` | Where the portal sends the customer when they leave. |
| `forward_url` | `string` | The portal page the link opens on. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Portal session (id, status, link_kind, created_at, access_expires_at, expires_at, login_at, logout_at, last_used_at, revoked_at, redirect_url, forward_url) |
| `404` | No such customer, or no such portal session |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/portal_sessions/psess_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
